title: GeoLeaf Basemaps
description: basemaps.json — basemap tile source definitions for a GeoLeaf profile. Strict schema (PRF-SCHEMA, Profile Contract v1). The `type` enum holds the 7 values the runtime maps, and every one of them is rendered — image, hillshade, wmts and wms included.

basemaps.description: Map of basemap entries keyed by basemap ID.

id.description: Basemap ID (mirrors the key in the parent object).

type.description: Source type — the 7 values the runtime maps (`_resolveBasemapType` and its dispatch). `raster` is a runtime alias of `tile` (default raster path). When omitted, defaults to the raster path.

fallbackUrl.description: Raster tile URL fallback when MapLibre GL is unavailable.

style.description: MapLibre GL style URL. Only for type: "maplibre".

tiles.description: Explicit tile URL array for MapLibre raster sources. Overrides url + subdomains expansion.

encoding.description: Tile encoding hint (e.g. for raster-dem sources).

defaultBasemap.description: Set to true to make this the active basemap on startup.

offline.description: Whether the offline preparation downloads this basemap. Its resources are only downloaded from the application's own origin or from an origin declared `cacheable: true` and `prefetch: true` in `modules.offline.dataOrigins` - declare a third-party origin only if its terms allow downloading ahead of use (OpenStreetMap forbids offline use of tile.openstreetmap.org).

crs.description: Coordinate reference system requested from the WMS server (e.g. `EPSG:3857`).

styles.description: WMS `STYLES` parameter. Empty string requests the server default.

tileSize.description: Tile size in pixels requested from the WMS server. Falls back to 256 when absent.

imageSource.description: Static image overlay source (georeferenced by coordinates).

hillshade.description: Relief shading drawn from a raster-dem source. Read in two ways. On a basemap of `type: "hillshade"` the shading IS the basemap. On a basemap of any other type it is read only when `overlay` is true, and is then drawn OVER that basemap, which stays what it is.

overlay.description: Draws the shading as an overlay of this basemap: just above the basemap's layer when it is an image (tiles, WMS, WMTS), inside the style when it is vector — see `beforeLayer`. Without it, a `hillshade` block on a basemap that is not of `type: "hillshade"` is ignored. Ignored on `type: "hillshade"`, whose shading is the basemap itself. The overlay reads a raster-dem source of its own, apart from the one of `terrain`: the same `demUrl` is then requested twice, for a shading one zoom level finer.

onlyWithTerrain.description: Overlay only: the shading is shown only while a 3D terrain is on the map, and hidden the rest of the time. Hidden, it requests no elevation tile: with a `terrain` block whose `activation` is `pitch`, a flat map stays exactly what it is without either block. On a basemap without an enabled `terrain` the overlay never shows. Without this key the overlay is always drawn. Ignored without `overlay`.

beforeLayer.description: Vector basemap only: id of the layer of the basemap's style the overlay is inserted before — typically its first water or road layer, so that the shading covers the land fills and stays under water, roads and labels. Absent, or naming a layer the style does not have: the overlay goes before the first `symbol` layer of the style, which keeps the labels readable but shades whatever is drawn under them, water and roads included.

accentColor.description: Accent colour of the hillshade layer (`hillshade-accent-color`). Any CSS colour.

illuminationAnchor.description: Whether the light source follows the viewport or is anchored to the map. MapLibre default: `viewport`.

terrain.description: 3D terrain / raster-dem configuration, read whatever the basemap type. What puts the relief on is `activation`: the selection of the basemap, when `default3D` is true, or the tilt of the camera.

enabled.description: Enables 3D terrain rendering for this basemap.

demUrl.description: URL template for the raster-dem tile source (may contain {z}/{x}/{y} placeholders). Required when enabled is true.

demEncoding.description: Tile encoding format for elevation data.

activation.description: What puts the terrain on. `basemap`: selecting the basemap does, when `default3D` is true; the camera is then posted to `pitch` and `bearing`, and eased back flat when the basemap is left. `pitch`: the terrain follows the tilt of the camera — absent while the map is flat, when no elevation tile is requested; put on once the camera comes to rest tilted to `activateFromPitch` or more; removed once it comes to rest under `deactivateBelowPitch`. The decision is taken when a movement ends, never during it, and the camera is never moved: `pitch`, `bearing` and `default3D: true` are refused with `pitch`.

activateFromPitch.description: With `activation: "pitch"` only, and refused without it: tilt, in degrees, from which the terrain is put on. Keep it at or under the map's `maxPitch`, or the terrain can never show.

deactivateBelowPitch.description: With `activation: "pitch"` only, and refused without it: tilt, in degrees, under which the terrain is removed. Must be lower than `activateFromPitch` — a value that is not is reported at start-up and replaced by the default. Default: half of `activateFromPitch`.

default3D.description: When true, 3D terrain activates automatically when this basemap is selected. Not read — and refused when true — with `activation: "pitch"`.

pitch.description: Camera pitch in degrees, posted when the terrain is activated by the selection of the basemap. Refused with `activation: "pitch"`, which never moves the camera.

bearing.description: Camera bearing in degrees, posted when the terrain is activated by the selection of the basemap. Refused with `activation: "pitch"`, which never moves the camera.

demMaxZoom.description: Maximum zoom of the DEM tile source. Falls back to 15 when absent.
